{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"詔大學士李光地等重為考定，以成是編。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126174244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"凡分六","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126190628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"目：一曰象數考原，二曰年神方位，三曰月事","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126190628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"吉神，四曰月事凶神，五曰日時總𩔖，六月用","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126190628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"事宜忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126190628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"每一目為一卷。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126207012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"考古者外事用剛日，","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126223396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748461102563365"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"内事用柔日，其日以卜不以擇。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126239780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"趙岐孟子註，","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126256164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"天時為孤虚王相，則戰國時巳漸講之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126256164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"然神","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126272548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"煞之説，則莫知所起。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126272548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"易緯乾鑿度有太乙行","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126288932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"九宫法。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126288932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙，天之貴神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126305316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"漢志兵家隂陽𩔖","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126321700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"亦稱順時而發，推刑徳，隨斗擊，因五勝，假鬼","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126321700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"神而為助。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126321700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"又隂陽家𩔖稱出於羲和之官。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126338084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"拘","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126354468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"者為之，則牽于禁忌，拘于小數，舍人事而任","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126354468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼神。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126354468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"則神煞之説，自漢代巳盛行矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126370852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"夫鬼神","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126387236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550109675554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"本乎二氣，二氣化為五行，以相生相尅為用。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126387236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"得其相生之氣，則其神吉；得其相尅之氣，則","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126403620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"其神凶，此亦自然之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126403620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"至其神各命以名，雖","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126420004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"似乎無稽，然物本無名，凡名皆人之所加。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126420004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126436388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"周天列宿，各有其名，亦人所加，非所本有。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126436388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"則","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126452772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂某神某神，不過假以記其方位，别其性","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126452772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"情而巳，不必以詞害意也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126452772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"厯代方技之家，所","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126469156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"傳不一，輾轉附益，其説愈繁，要以不悖于隂陽","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126469156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550109691938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之理者近是。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126469156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"是書簡汰諸家，删其鄙倍，","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126485540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"而括其綱要，于以順天之道，宜民之用。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126485540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：甲戊庚牛羊，乙已鼠猴鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810111039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁豬鷄位，壬癸兔蛇","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810127423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"藏。","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810127423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛逢馬虎，此是貴人方。","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810143807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：天乙者，乃","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810160191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"紫㣲垣左樞傍之一星，萬神之主掌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810160191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"一日二者，隂","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810176575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"陽分治內外之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810176575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌為魁罡之位，故貴人不臨。","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810192959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748671992086566"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"戊以配中央之位，乃勾陳后宫之象，故與甲同其起","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810209343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"例，以丑乃紫㣲後門之左，陽界之辰也；未乃紫㣲南","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810209343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"門之右，隂界之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810209343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"甲者，十干之首，故陽貴以甲加","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810225727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"丑逆行，甲得丑，乙得子，丙得亥，丁得酉，巳得申，庚得","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810225727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"未，辛得午，壬得已，癸得卯，此晝日之貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810225727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"隂貴以甲","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810242111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"加未順行，甲得未，乙得申，丙得酉，丁得亥，巳得子，庚","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810242111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"得丑，辛得寅，壬得卯，癸得已，此暮夜之貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810242111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"戊以助","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810258495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"甲成功，故亦得丑未。","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810258495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"若六辛之獨得寅午，則自然所","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810274879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748701117186089"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"致，更無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810274879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"又，通書云：郭景純以十干貴人為吉神之首，至静而能","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810291263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"制羣動，至尊而能鎮飛浮，以其為坤，黄中通理，乃貴","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810291263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"人之徳。","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810291263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"是以陽貴人出於先天之坤而順，隂貴人出","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810307647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"於後天之坤而逆。","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810307647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"天干之徳未足為貴，而干徳之合","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810324031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"氣乃為貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049112810324031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":3254,"lineType":1,"content":"按：以上立成所載等日，皆從陰陽二建起論，於選","logicSentenceId":"7679051374625931307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":3256,"lineType":1,"content":"擇他書無所見，姑附於此。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374625931307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748721078124582"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":3260,"lineType":1,"content":"御定星厯考原卷五","logicSentenceId":"7679051374625947691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶之説，昉於易，衍於疇，所以順性命之理，盡變化之","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106901544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"道，而教人卜筮，以為趨避之宜者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106901544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"然隂陽既分，剛柔","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106917928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"定位，五行順布，則生尅無端；干支相推，則衝合互見，以","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106917928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"及納音、納甲，𣲖衍而枝分；八卦九宫，同條而共貫，皆推","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106917928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748719970779148"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"原於易理，根柢於圖書，論日以繁，術日以巧，是不可謂","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106917928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"理之所必無，而亦勢之所必至者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106917928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"三代而後，隂陽家","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106934312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"者流，各出其説，以鳴於世，亦已紛矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106934312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"况一日之間，有吉","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106950696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"神，又有凶神，且有一神而異名者。","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106950696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"異其名矣，又有一為","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106967080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，一為凶者。","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106967080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"夫神煞之名，不過即五行之生旺、休、囚，干","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106983464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"支之刑衝、合、㑹以為斷耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106983464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"術數之徒，乃甚言其吉凶，以","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106999848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"駭衆而震俗，偶有所驗，羣焉信之，而古之立説，茫乎莫","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106999848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"知其所由來矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679050888106999848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"今吉凶神煞，既為註釋，而又即用事註","logicSentenceId":"7679050888107016232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748701117431849"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"其宜忌，以為選擇之例，亦皆仍厯書之舊云。","logicSentenceId":"7679050888107032616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
